name: WalkRay AI – Product Listing Optimizer
author: taoye003

sections.description:
WalkRay AI helps you create SEO-optimized product listings for your WooCommerce store. With support for DeepSeek (direct connection from China, no VPN required) and OpenAI, you can generate complete product descriptions, run SEO audits, create Schema markup, and optimize image ALT text – all from the product edit screen.

Features

  • One-Click AI Generation – Generate complete product listings (short description, full description, SEO title, meta description, tags) with a single click.
  • SEO Audit and Readability Scoring – AI scores your product content 0-100. Checks sentence length, paragraph density, keyword usage, and readability with specific fix suggestions.
  • SEO Rewrite – AI rewrites existing product descriptions for Yoast green-light compliance.
  • JSON-LD Schema Generator – One-click Product Schema markup for Google Rich Results.
  • ALT Text Generator – AI generates descriptive, SEO-friendly ALT text for product images.
  • Multi-API Support – Choose between DeepSeek (China direct), OpenAI, or custom API endpoint.
  • Multi-Language – Generate in English, Chinese, German, Japanese, French, and Spanish.
  • Clean Sidebar UI – Non-intrusive meta box on the product edit page.

Free Features

All features are free and unlimited:
* AI description generation (short + full)
* SEO Audit and Readability scoring
* SEO Rewrite for existing descriptions
* JSON-LD Product Schema generator
* ALT text generator
* DeepSeek / OpenAI / Custom API

WalkRay Pro (Separate Plugin)

The Pro version is a separate plugin available at walkray.com ($39/year), offering:
* Bulk generation for multiple products
* AI keyword research and analysis
* Competitor listing analyzer
* 10+ additional languages
* Priority email support

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party AI API services to generate product content.

DeepSeek
* API Endpoint: https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions
* Purpose: AI content generation, SEO auditing, schema generation
* Data sent: Product title, category, keywords, and existing description
* Terms of Service: https://platform.deepseek.com/policies/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://platform.deepseek.com/policies/privacy

OpenAI
* API Endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
* Purpose: AI content generation, SEO auditing, schema generation
* Data sent: Product title, category, keywords, and existing description
* Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
* Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the walkray-listing-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to WalkRay AI > Settings, choose your API provider and enter your API key.
  4. Edit any WooCommerce product – the WalkRay AI panel appears on the right.

API Keys

  • DeepSeek (no VPN in China): Register at platform.deepseek.com
  • OpenAI: Register at platform.openai.com
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes. You bring your own API key (DeepSeek or OpenAI). Your key is stored securely in your WordPress database.

Which is cheaper, DeepSeek or OpenAI?

DeepSeek is significantly cheaper for Chinese users and does not require VPN.

Is there a usage limit?

No. All built-in features are unlimited and free. WalkRay Pro (separate plugin at walkray.com) offers additional features like bulk generation and competitor analysis.

What data does this plugin store?

The plugin stores only your API key in your WordPress database. No product data, user data, or generated content is stored or transmitted to our servers. All AI processing happens directly between your server and the API provider.

Is this plugin compatible with Yoast SEO?

Yes. WalkRay AI generates content that follows Yoast SEO best practices.
